craft_notes: Sthāyin: fragmentation. Sanskrit-first: nineteen-by-eight kept. Rows: 2. Close: told. Rejected: decay reading — killed: rule, not ruin. Read aloud: splitting cadence.

lines: Nineteen shards, each split eight ways.
